title: Vertex raw proxy is dispatched through VertexAIProvider to its delegate providers
answers: where does a Vertex AI proxy request get routed to the MaaS or Claude provider
how do I test the Vertex raw proxy route end to end
which provider handles /gateway/proxy for vertex_ai models
body:
VertexAIProvider forwards its raw proxy call to the delegate provider chosen for the model (Claude or MaaS), so a delegate's _proxy override is reached only through VertexAIProvider.
Flow: VertexAIProvider (proxy) -> delegate _proxy -> for MaaS, _VertexAIMaaSProvider._proxy posts to the /endpoints/openapi base.
Tests for this route go through VertexAIProvider.proxy, not the delegate directly, so the forwarding is covered.
If a new Vertex delegate needs different proxy URL handling, override _proxy on that delegate; the forwarding in VertexAIProvider is what makes that override live.
applies: Debugging or adding raw proxy behaviour for Vertex AI models in the gateway.

search: `VertexAIProvider` in `mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py` dispatches raw proxy calls by forwarding to the delegate provider (Claude or MaaS) chosen for the model. For MaaS, `_VertexAIMaaSProvider._proxy` posts to the `/endpoints/openapi` base. Applies to debugging or adding raw proxy behavior for Vertex AI models; delegates needing custom proxy URL handling must override `_proxy`, and end-to-end tests must call `VertexAIProvider.proxy` rather than the delegate directly.
